create_feedback_record: create a feedback record with run_id, thread_id, rating and optional comment using FeedbackRepository
upsert_feedback_by_user: upsert a feedback record that creates new or updates existing feedback per user and run
list_feedback_by_thread: list all feedback records grouped by thread_id or run_id using FeedbackRepository list methods
aggregate_feedback_statistics: aggregate feedback statistics by run to get total, positive, and negative counts
store_follow_up_run_metadata: store a run with follow_up_to_run_id metadata in MemoryRunStore to link follow-up runs
